page.overview:
What is Dead Kennedy Rolls?

Dead Kennedy Rolls is a song featured on the Presidio demos recorded sometime between 2002 and 2003.

This song has actually been performed live twice by the band; once during a small gig at Club Kimo's, and another time at Metallica HQ. Unfortunately, there is no full live recording of this song, as Metallica made a surprise appearance at Kimo's and no recordings were ever found of the song at HQ. One reason to believe this song will never be performed live again is thought to be because the main riff from "Dead Kennedy Rolls" later became a part of Metallica's song "St. Anger". So what was once one song, later became another, and is now the reason we will never hear this song again.
